name: decline_meeting_invite
description:
Decline a calendar meeting invite.

WRITE — CONFIRM FIRST, EXTERNAL SIDE EFFECTS. This changes calendar state and is not silent: declining sends an RSVP that the organizer and often every other attendee can see, and it cannot be un-sent. A wrongly declined meeting has real social and professional cost. Show the user the specific event (title, time, organizer) and get explicit confirmation of that eventId before calling.

eventId.description: The ID of the calendar event
